verdict.rationale: Gusto's agent-friendly CLI and its bundled payroll-prep skill let an agent build a draft payroll for review, with --dry-run previews and a --confirm gate that keeps a human in the loop. The CLI has no submit command, so approval stays with the user. Upcoming unprocessed payrolls can be retrieved via the API, and the contractor-payment preview endpoint returns submission_blockers. However, nothing documents anomaly detection or flagging on regular payroll runs, and the only documented preview endpoint with blockers covers contractor payments, not employee payroll. Missing for 10: a documented regular-payroll calculate/preview endpoint, built-in anomaly detection or variance surfacing, and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent preview-and-review flow.
